articles.preview_en: The photographer was holidaying with his family when two shadows became a plaything for his young son Gellért Gombai, his wife and two children spend much of the year at their home in Budapest, Hungar
articles.preview_ru: The photographer was holidaying with his family when two shadows became a plaything for his young son Gellért Gombai, his wife and two children spend much of the year at their home in Budapest, Hungar
articles.full_en: The photographer was holidaying with his family when two shadows became a plaything for his young son Gellért Gombai, his wife and two children spend much of the year at their home in Budapest, Hungary, but most of their summers in Alsóörs. “It’s a small holiday village on Lake Balaton, the largest in central Europe, so it’s often referred to as the Hungarian sea,” Gombai, a freelance photographer, says. “We go to the playground and beach most days, swim, and eat beach food, but even when I’m enjoying my holiday, I’m looking out for interesting moments to capture.” On this particular day, the family had eaten hotdogs for lunch, before Gombai had taken the kids, Lóci and Janka, to the playground. “Lóci, who was five at the time, was jumping between two shadows – one from a changing room, and the other from a building’s roof,” he says. “I asked him to stay still for a few minutes while I got the shot, and he lay like this on the ground. He’s a big-hearted little clown; I’m so glad he’s my son.” When he showed the children, “Janka immediately asked me to take the same shot of her, which often happens. Lóci said it looked like he was among mountains, or as though a monster was about to eat him.” Continue reading...

articles.title_en: Mark Wahlberg Announces Affordable Longevity Gym Concept.
articles.title_ru: Марк Уолберг объявил о доступном концепте фитнесцентра долголетия.
articles.preview_en: Mark Wahlberg unveiled an affordable gym that combines cold‑plunge therapy, blood‑panel testing and protein‑rich snacks.
articles.preview_ru: Марк Уолберг представил доступный фитнесцентр с холодным погружением, анализом крови и протеиновыми закусками.
articles.full_en: Mark Wahlberg announced the launch of an affordable gym that integrates longevity services such as cold‑plunge tubs, on‑site blood panels and protein‑enhanced muffins. The new concept promises members access to advanced health monitoring without the high fees typical of boutique wellness clubs. Industry analysts note that Wahlberg’s previous investment in a gym chain that later delisted from the NYSE gave him insight into scaling fitness operations. The significance of the model lies in democratizing cutting‑edge health tools that were previously reserved for elite athletes and wealthy patrons. Broader implications suggest that other fitness entrepreneurs may adopt similar low‑cost, data‑driven approaches, reshaping the market. Consumers can now book a cold plunge, receive a quick blood panel and grab a protein muffin during a single workout session, simplifying health routines. The venture positions Wahlberg as a pioneer in making longevity technology accessible to everyday gym‑goers.
articles.full_ru: Марк Уолберг объявил о запуске доступного фитнесцентра, который объединяет услуги долголетия, такие как холодные погружения, анализ крови на месте и протеиновые кексы. Концепция обещает членам доступ к передовым методам мониторинга здоровья без высоких цен, характерных для элитных клубов. Эксперты отрасли отмечают, что предыдущие инвестиции Уолберга в сеть спортзалов, которая была снята с биржи , дали ему опыт масштабирования фитнесопераций. Значение модели состоит в демократизации передовых инструментов здоровья, ранее доступных только элитным спортсменам и состоятельным клиентам. Широкие последствия могут подтолкнуть других предпринимателей фитнеса к внедрению аналогичных недорогих, основанных на данных решений, меняя рынок. Пользователи теперь могут одновременно воспользоваться холодным погружением, получить быстрый анализ крови и съесть протеиновый кекс за одну тренировку, упрощая свои оздоровительные привычки. Проект ставит Уолберга в роль пионера, делающего технологии долголетия доступными обычным посетителям спортзалов.
articles.meta_en: Mark Wahlberg’s new affordable gym blends cold‑plunge therapy, blood testing and protein snacks to bring longevity tech to everyday members.
